C0802.title: Case of a 1069 Code Sub-Agent Assisting Telecom Fraudsters in Sending Phishing SMS
C0802.summary: The Haidian District People's Procuratorate's Cybersecurity Protection Prosecution White Paper (2016-2021) disclosed that a technology company operated by Chen was a third-level agent for the '1069' service code. Chen rented numbers to telecom fraud criminals, enabling them to impersonate traffic authorities and financial institutions and send bulk SMS messages containing shortened phishing links to victims under pretexts such as driving tests and online loans.

references.title: Haidian District Procuratorate Releases Cybersecurity Protection Prosecution White Paper (2016-2021)
